## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Yuènán jīng* (T537) is a one-fascicle short sūtra by Niè Chéngyuǎn 聶承遠 ([聶承遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%81%B6%E6%89%BF%E9%81%A0)), the principal Chinese collaborator of Dharmarakṣa and father of Niè Dàozhēn ([聶道真](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%81%B6%E9%81%93%E7%9C%9F), cf. [KR6i0064](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0064), [KR6i0112](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0112)). The protagonist's name *Yuènán* 越難 ("Crossing-of-Difficulty") may be a Chinese semantic translation rather than transliteration.

**Abstract**

A short *avadāna*-style narrative. Niè Chéngyuǎn was active 280–311 CE in the Western Jìn, principally as Dharmarakṣa's chief Chinese editor; this text is one of the few independently attributed to him.
